rules: Upload and access grants are short-lived, server-bound and never expose object credentials, permanent URLs or client-selected authority facts.
Media publish eligibility requires READY and CLEAN source media, valid rights and an official subtitle or text alternative; unknown or stale facts deny publication and delivery.
MediaManifest is metadata-only and contains exactly one TEXT_ALTERNATIVE and one PRACTICE_ALTERNATIVE with explicit availability reasons.
Adult remote voice recording requires the dedicated IAM-derived VOICE_RECORDING consent purpose and version; microphone denial preserves silent practice and never fabricates remote success.
Only assessment-service owns shadowing session, attempt and rule result facts; media-service owns the recording asset and learning-service consumes only trusted assessment results.
Phase 1 disables ASR, AI scoring, generative AI, digital human and RTC; historical media and recording events remain historical-only.
Static contracts, generated types, tests and B26 candidates cannot promote object-store, worker, database, broker, browser or device runtime readiness.
